mentions.name: Tide Flag
mentions.description: This is a mechanical, tide-powered device that turns a weather-vane-like flag in sync with the ebb and flow of the tide, built to withstand the elements and look cool. The author plans to add an ESP32 and Z-Wave to it to feed data into their Home Assistant setup.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A tide flag.  As in, a mechanical device that turns a weather-vane-like flag that moves with the ebb and flow.  It has to be powered by the tide, and must be able to withstand the elements.  And, must look cool.

Then, I will slap an ESP32 & z-wave on it :D secretly to feed my Home Assistant. :D
